أرتهط (form VIII)
# أَرْتَهِطُ (ʔartahiṭu) /ʔar.ta.hi.tˤu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِرْتَهَطَ (irtahaṭa)
# أَرْتَهِطَ (ʔartahiṭa) /ʔar.ta.hi.tˤa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَهَطَ (irtahaṭa)
# أَرْتَهِطْ (ʔartahiṭ) /ʔar.ta.hitˤ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِرْتَهَطَ (irtahaṭa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
